notablePrerequisites:
Elemental Mastery attached to Battered Golem.
Battered Golem does not have summoning sickness.
description:
Activate Battered Golem by tapping it, creating three 1/1 Elemental creature tokens with haste.
Activate Prosperous Partnership by tapping the Elementals, creating a Treasure token.
When the Treasure enters the battlefield, Battered Golem triggers, untapping itself.
Repeat.
